verdicts.title: An algebro-geometric study of special values of hypergeometric functions ${}_3F_2$
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: For certain class of hypergeometric functions ${}_3F_2$ with rational parameters, we give a sufficient condition for the special value at $1$ to be expressed in terms of logarithms of algebraic numbers. We give two proofs, both of which are algebro-geometric and related to higher regulators.
verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract concerns special values of hypergeometric functions ${}_3F_2$ expressed via logarithms of algebraic numbers, with no mention of CNF formulas, Frege proof depth, or invariant rank — it only shares the loose 'algebro-geometric' vocabulary.

verdicts.title: Algorithms in Real Algebraic Geometry: A Survey

verdicts.title: An algebro-geometric perspective on the topology of moduli spaces of differentials
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: Differentials on Riemann surfaces correspond to translation surfaces with conical singularities, and affine transformations acting on them preserve the orders of these singularities.
